_about: Labelled volunteer descriptions for tools/measure_skill_suggestions.py (issue #216). 'expected' are the skills a good answer must find; 'acceptable' are other IDs that are also right and so do not count against precision. An empty 'expected' means the right answer is no suggestion at all. Every ID must be a selectable leaf in utils/predict_category_list.py; tests/test_skill_suggestion_eval.py enforces this.

cases.description: I'm a retired math teacher. I can help students with algebra and with SAT preparation.
I'm a licensed electrician and I also do some plumbing work on weekends.
I work as a nurse. I also cook for large community events, and I'm happy to drive people to their appointments.
I like helping older people set up video calls with their families on phones and tablets.
I do sewing and clothing alterations. I can also help people write resumes and practise for job interviews.
I teach kids how to code, and I review college application essays.
I have a pickup truck and I help people move house.
I'm a licensed counsellor and I can offer emotional support to people who are struggling.
Gardening, painting and general handyman jobs around the house.
I'm free on weekends and happy to help.
